limitations: Configured input numbering is Cinemeta; the native call does not identify the selected metadata addon.
Incomplete or ambiguous metadata, nonmatching titles/dates and oversized bodies do not establish correspondence.
Only successful correspondence is cached; no media URL, player, grant or caption cache.
Isolated Custom checks exclude Omega/SwiftFlow; normal worker checks without a TMDB key cannot cover Omega correspondence.
The initial HTTP 404 remains an upstream failure in audit results even when recovery media passes.
Fresh signed media URLs vary; exact URL equality is not used as episode identity proof.
Bounded media reads do not certify physical playback, every rendition, all subtitle content or seek positions.
